title: teams-cli append-only operation event, version 1
description: One immutable observation, action or assessment. Append order is not occurrence order. A missing result never proves that an action did not execute.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this event's contract; old records are never migrated in place.

eventId.description: Stable event identity, independent of file position or timestamps.

operationId.description: Session or standalone operation identity; one continuous file across a session's commands.

commandId.description: Command context identity. Distinct commands in one session have distinct IDs; between commands, input retains the last context without implying causation.

stepId.description: Identity shared by a step's start, dispatch and later assessments.

seq.description: Monotonic append sequence assigned by the one writer. Not proof of causal or occurrence order.

timestamp.description: UTC occurrence time if the source supplies it; otherwise observation time. See timestampSource and clockId.

timestampSource.description: source: occurrence time supplied by the originating component; observer: fallback observation time, not claimed as the true occurrence instant.

clockId.description: Clock domain for the timestamp; different clocks must not be presumed synchronized.

recordedAt.description: UTC instant the writer recorded the event, possibly later than its occurrence.

oneOf.description: Action requested/performed by the agent, established by executor dispatch or explicit correlation.
Direct human interaction with supported attribution; a trusted DOM event alone is insufficient evidence.
Occurrence produced by Teams, such as an observed response or UI change.
Executor infrastructure occurrence: timer, gate, lifecycle or assessment.
Observed occurrence whose origin cannot be established. Includes uncorrelated CDP versus human input.

component.description: Component recording this event; distinct from the originator and causal predecessor.

event.description: Semantic event name, e.g. command.received, step.started, input.observed or gate.released.

evidence.description: Distinguishes observed facts, requested actions and conclusions from evidence.

causedBy.description: Established causal predecessors, not events merely close in time.

supersedes.description: Previous assessments replaced by this assessment for the same step. Never deletes or replaces an attempted action or observation.

reason.description: Why the origin, outcome or ordering is unknown.

data.description: Selected event-specific metadata. Never scripts, arguments containing text, keystroke contents, clipboard contents, full protocol payloads or credentials.
